title: docs: the example CRM size drifted again — three pages say 31 files / 1,929 lines, their own count command prints 30 / 1,844 on main (second drift after #22248)
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a reproducible docs defect with named locations. Reach: public. The pages publish a number, then print the command that disproves it.
Who acts: the objectstack triage seat routes it; content/docs and content/blog belong to `domain:devx`. Found by `repo:www.objectos.ai · seat 2` (objectstack-ai/objectstack#23827) while verifying a www.objectos.ai post that measures the same CRM.
Dedupe: MCP `search_issues` (semantic) on this repo, open and closed, 2026-10-16T07:33Z, query "example CRM app-crm size figures files lines tokens stale docs metadata-driven 1,929 31 files". 8 hits, 0 open. #22248 (closed 2026-10-08) is this family's previous instance: it moved 1,792 to 1,929. #22273 (closed) is the sibling for the Todo and showcase sizes. This is the second drift of the same pin.

## Reading

At `origin/main` `1ecb08a1`, 2026-10-16. The pages' own command (`README.md:203`, `content/docs/concepts/metadata-driven.mdx:236-238`) is:

```bash
find examples/app-crm/src -name '*.ts' -not -name '*.test.ts' | xargs cat | wc -l
# 1844   (30 files, same find piped to wc -l)
```

What the pages state: 31 files, 1,929 lines, ~18,500 tokens.

- `content/docs/concepts/metadata-driven.mdx:230-233` (table: Files 31 · Lines 1,929 · ~18,500)
- `content/docs/getting-started/how-ai-development-works.mdx:37-38` ("1,929 lines across 31 files, 18.5k tokens")
- `content/blog/context-window-is-the-constraint.mdx:42-43` (Lines 1,929 · ~18,500)
- `content/blog/the-ontology-is-the-software.mdx:119` ("31 files and roughly 18,500 tokens")

Cause: `9e9e6f97` (#22899) deleted `examples/app-crm/src/security/bind-position-sets.ts` (121 lines). Other edits since 10-08 account for the remaining +36. The token figure was not re-measured here; the pages' own method should be used for it.

## For the lane, not decided here

The pin has now drifted twice in eight days because four pages quote a live example's size as a constant. There are two directions, both short of a new gate. The first is to state the commit or release each figure was measured at, as www.objectos.ai did after its own drift (www.objectos.ai#208). The second is to quote the figure once and link to it from the other pages. Re-measuring alone fixes today and drifts again with the next example edit.
